summary: The same pipeline and key-list fallback. LEGACY_KEY_SCAN is "false" at the top level but "true" in env.staging, which has its own public Custom Domain.

expected_findings.contains: await env.KEYS.list<{ secret: string; name: string }>({ prefix: "legacy:", cursor })
expected_findings.explanation: vars are not inherited by env blocks, and env.staging sets LEGACY_KEY_SCAN to "true". The staging Worker is deployed on its own public hostname and bills the same account, so the fallback is live there: any request with an unknown token lists every legacy key before the 401, with no rate limit in front. It is rated where it is on, not at the top-level value.
